agent_templates.name: Research Scout
agent_templates.purpose: Watch markets, news, liquidity, and token metadata; emits non-executing signals.

agent_templates.name: Risk Sentinel
agent_templates.purpose: Checks pair gates, wallet gates, daily limits, exposure, volatility, and blocked jurisdictions before any order path.

agent_templates.name: Paper Market Maker
agent_templates.purpose: Places policy-gated paper maker quotes and records spread/latency receipts.

agent_templates.name: Portfolio Router
agent_templates.purpose: Routes simulated intent across chains, wallets, and venues without custody.

agent_templates.name: Receipt Auditor
agent_templates.purpose: Indexes orders, fills, wallet evaluations, and benchmark receipts into proof lanes.

agent_launch_requirements: wallet connected or operator test identity present
policy evaluation approved or human approval requested
target chain is supported by registry
